records.name: Tamil Nadu Agricultural University (TNAU)
records.description: Tamil Nadu Agricultural University (TNAU) in Coimbatore is a premier agricultural university in India, consistently ranked among the top three agricultural universities nationally, offering undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral programs across agronomy, horticulture, agricultural engineering, and biotechnology. TNAU has released hundreds of high-yielding, climate-resilient crop varieties suited to Tamil Nadu's diverse agro-climatic zones and conducts extensive agricultural extension services. It is a key institution for Tamil Nadu's agriculture-dependent economy and trains the next generation of agricultural scientists, extension workers, and agripreneurs.

records.name: Punjab Agricultural University (PAU)
records.description: Punjab Agricultural University (PAU) in Ludhiana is among Asia's most respected agricultural universities, historically playing a defining role in India's Green Revolution with its high-yielding wheat and rice varieties. PAU offers B.Sc. Agriculture, B.Tech. (Food Technology), M.Sc., and Ph.D. programs and maintains over a dozen research stations across Punjab supporting farmers with location-specific agronomic solutions. The university is particularly known for its work on wheat improvement, drip irrigation, and precision agriculture technologies suited to Punjab's farming landscape.

records.name: IIT Kharagpur - Agricultural & Food Engineering
records.description: IIT Kharagpur's Agricultural and Food Engineering (AgFE) Department is India's oldest and most prestigious agricultural engineering program, offering B.Tech., M.Tech., and Ph.D. programs in food technology, food process engineering, and agricultural systems engineering. The department integrates engineering principles with food science and agricultural systems, producing graduates who lead India's food processing and agri-machinery industries. IIT Kharagpur AgFE is known for research in precision agriculture, food quality analytics, and sustainable post-harvest technology.

records.name: MANAGE Hyderabad
records.description: National Institute of Agricultural Extension Management (MANAGE) in Hyderabad is an autonomous institution under the Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, offering postgraduate diploma, executive programs, and training for agricultural extension officers and agri-business managers. MANAGE is recognized for strengthening India's agricultural extension system through capacity building of extension workers, KVK (Krishi Vigyan Kendra) staff, and state agriculture department officials. Its programs in agribusiness management, farm entrepreneurship, and rural development management are offered both as residential and online programs.

records.name: IIM Lucknow - PGP-SM
records.description: IIM Lucknow's Post Graduate Programme in Sustainable Management (PGP-SM) at its Noida campus is a specialized MBA program focusing on sustainable business, corporate social responsibility, and ESG (Environmental, Social, Governance) management. The program combines rigorous management education with sustainability frameworks, preparing graduates for leadership roles in sustainable business, impact investing, and CSR strategy. IIM Lucknow Noida campus placements span leading corporates with mature sustainability programs, NGOs, and ESG consulting firms.

records.name: Indian Institute of Corporate Affairs (IICA)
records.description: Indian Institute of Corporate Affairs (IICA) in Manesar is an autonomous body under the Ministry of Corporate Affairs, offering postgraduate programs, certificate courses, and training in company law, corporate governance, insolvency, CSR, and competition law. It serves as the government's capacity building arm for corporate professionals, company secretaries, and IBBI (Insolvency and Bankruptcy Board of India) registered professionals. IICA has a growing international collaboration profile and plays a key role in India's corporate regulatory ecosystem.

records.name: School of Planning and Architecture (SPA)
records.description: School of Planning and Architecture (SPA) New Delhi is India's oldest and most prestigious national institution for architecture and planning, established in 1959 and accorded the status of Institution of National Importance. It offers B.Arch., B.Plan., M.Arch., M.Plan., and Ph.D. programs with faculties covering architecture, planning, industrial design, and landscape architecture. SPA Delhi graduates have shaped India's built environment and urban planning frameworks, serving in government agencies, leading design firms, and international development organizations.

records.name: TERI - The Energy and Resources Institute
records.description: The Energy and Resources Institute (TERI) in New Delhi is India's foremost research organization in sustainable development, energy policy, clean technology, and environmental governance, with global influence through TERIIN and its subsidiaries. TERI conducts research across renewable energy, climate change adaptation, natural resource management, and clean transport, informing national and international policy. Through TERI School of Advanced Studies, TERI offers graduate and doctoral programs for students aspiring to careers in sustainability and development.

records.name: Indian Green Building Council (IGBC)
records.description: Indian Green Building Council (IGBC) in Hyderabad is the apex national body for green building certification, capacity building, and advocacy in India, operating under the Confederation of Indian Industry (CII). IGBC offers the IGBC AP (Accredited Professional) certification programs that are industry standard for green building professionals in India, training architects, engineers, and construction managers in sustainable building design and LEED/IGBC-aligned rating systems. IGBC has facilitated green certification for over 12 billion sq ft of registered green building space in India, making it one of the world's largest green building movements.

records.name: IIT Roorkee - Architecture Department
records.description: IIT Roorkee's Department of Architecture and Planning is one of India's leading architecture departments, offering B.Arch., M.Arch., and Ph.D. programs with strengths in sustainable architecture, heritage conservation, and urban design. The department leverages IIT Roorkee's overall engineering excellence and its proximity to the Himalayas and heritage cities of Uttarakhand for unique field study opportunities. IIT Roorkee architecture graduates are placed in leading design firms, urban development agencies, and academic institutions across India and abroad.
